    Architecture notes
    
Pipeline. ProblemGenerator maps a level to a complexity target and a set of numeric constraints, picks a problem domain, and asks the domain for a candidate AST built backwards from a chosen answer. ProblemValidator checks the candidate independently: it evaluates the AST exactly with BigInt and, for equations, expands both sides into exact rational polynomials. ComplexityScorer scores the candidate. The generator then rescales its internal budget toward the target and retries, up to a bounded number of attempts, and keeps the closest valid candidate.

    
Complexity. targetComplexity(level) = base + level × growth. The score is Σ operator costs + 0.8·Σ log₁₀(|literal|+1) + 0.5·(depth−1) + 0.75·(distinct operators−1) + exponent terms + 0.6·parentheses + fraction nesting + algebraic terms. The algebraic terms cover the equation, variable occurrences, polynomial degree, products of variable factors, and 3·d(d−1) for any additive block of degree d that must be factored.

    
Extending. Register a new operator with Operators.register({...}), giving its cost, precedence, evaluate, decompose (the reverse step) and poly hooks. Register a new problem domain, such as determinants or systems, with Domains.register({...}) and ProblemValidator.register(name, fn). The scorer, renderer, tests and UI pick both up automatically.
